target: http://localhost:3792

Findings (each reproduced twice from scratch)
1. MEDIUM Journal page shows a malformed list response as a list of blank entries
   where: /journal (GET /api/journal?limit=50)
   expected: A malformed response shows an error such as 'Could not load the journal.'
   saw: {"alerts":["14 entries"],"text":["Journal","The latest notes from across the garden, newest first.","Write in a plant's journal","Search","14 entries","–","–","–","–","–","–","–","–","–","–","–","–","–","–","Garden Log · a journal for one garden"],"pe":[]}
   repro: .rough-ride/runs/20261112-173407-hunt-0a37/probes/plant-journal-load-faults.mjs (expectation "journal-malformed-not-shown-as-entries")
2. MEDIUM Plant journal shows a malformed response as blank entries with Edit and Delete buttons
   where: /plants/:id Journal section (GET /api/journal?plant_id=…)
   expected: An error saying the journal could not be loaded
   saw: {"alerts":[],"text":["Journal","2 entries","New entry","Date","Entry","500 characters left","Add entry","Entries, newest first","–","Edit","entry from –","Delete","entry from –","–","Edit","entry from –","Delete","entry from –","–","Edit","entry from –","Delete","entry from –","–","Edit"],"pe":[]}
   repro: .rough-ride/runs/20261112-173407-hunt-0a37/probes/plant-journal-load-faults.mjs (expectation "plant-journal-malformed-not-shown-as-entries")
3. MEDIUM Plant journal shows a bad response as 'No journal entries yet' while the badge says 2 entries
   where: /plants/:id Journal section
   expected: A response that is not a list is shown as a load error
   saw: {"alerts":[],"text":["Journal","2 entries","New entry","Date","Entry","500 characters left","Add entry","Entries, newest first","No journal entries yet","Note what you see: first shoots, pests, the weather.","Garden Log · a journal for one garden"],"pe":[]}
   repro: .rough-ride/runs/20261112-173407-hunt-0a37/probes/plant-journal-load-faults.mjs (expectation "plant-journal-empty-object-not-shown-as-empty")
4. MEDIUM Journal search shows a bad response as 'No entries match'
   where: /journal search (GET /api/journal?q=…)
   expected: A response that is not a list is shown as an error
   saw: {"alerts":["0 entries match"],"text":["Journal","The latest notes from across the garden, newest first.","Write in a plant's journal","Search","Clear search","0 entries match","No entries match","Try a different word or plant name.","Clear search","Garden Log · a journal for one garden"]}
   repro: .rough-ride/runs/20261112-173407-hunt-0a37/probes/plant-journal-load-faults.mjs (expectation "journal-empty-object-not-shown-as-no-match")
5. MEDIUM Hung journal search stays on 'Loading entries…' and keeps showing the old results
   where: /journal search
   expected: After a while the page shows an error or a timeout and offers a retry
   saw: {"alerts":["Loading entries…"],"text":["Write in a plant's journal","Search","Clear search","Loading entries…","Tomato","2 Jul 2026","Tied the stems to canes.","Tomato","1 Jun 2026","First flowers opened; watered deeply."]}
   repro: .rough-ride/runs/20261112-173407-hunt-0a37/probes/journal-search-hang.mjs (expectation "hung-search-not-stuck-loading")
